title_en: Graff to Stand at Eureka Stud
description: In a welcome addition to the Queensland breeding ranks, Graff will relocate to Eureka Stud for the 2026 breeding season. He is the sire of boom 3-year-old sprinter Grafterburners, already a six-time winner and earner of more than AU$2.1 million.

title_en: Golden Tempo Turns In First Breeze at The Spa
description: Kentucky Derby (G1) and Belmont Stakes (G1) winner Golden Tempo breezed 4 furlongs in :48.51, according to NYRA clockers. Owned by Phipps Stable and St. Elias Stable, the colt's current objective is the Aug. 29 Travers Stakes.

title_en: Canterbury Park Cancels July 26 Card Due to Heat
description: Racing at Canterbury Park in Shakopee, Minn. was canceled July 26 due to projected extreme heat during the afternoon. High heat also led to Prairie Meadows adjusting first post time for both Sunday and July 27.

title_en: Cornucopian Euthanized Following Bing Crosby Injury
description: After sustaining an injury to his right-front fetlock during the July 25 Bing Crosby Stakes (G1) at Del Mar, dual graded stakes winner Cornucopian was euthanized, Tom Ryan of co-owner SF Racing announced July 26.

title_en: Counting Stars Exits CCA Oaks in 'Unbelievable' Shape
description: Counting Stars exited her July 25 victory in the Coaching Club American Oaks (G1) in "unbelievable" shape, according to trainer Mark Casse.

title_en: Japan's Global Racing Quest Continues
description: Satono Reve, who finished second in the Queen Elizabeth II Jubilee Stakes (G1) at Ascot June 20 and third in the July Cup (G1) at Newmarket July 11, will likely make his next start in the City of York Stakes (G1) Aug. 22.

title_en: Listenupshance Loud and Clear in Bing Crosby Thriller
description: Listenupshance tosses his name into the conversation for the Breeders' Cup Sprint (G1) with his narrow victory over Maximum Bourbon in the win-and-you're-in Bing Crosby Stakes (G1) July 25 at Del Mar.

title_en: Ortiz Jr. Ties Single-Day Saratoga Win Record With Six
description: Jockey Irad Ortiz Jr. won six races on the Saratoga Race Course's 12-race card, tying the single-day win record previously set by Hall of Famers John Velazquez and Ramon Dominguez.

title_en: Creed's Gold Repeats in Hendrie Stakes at Woodbine
description: Kristin Meldahl's Creed's Gold takes the $124,169 Hendrie Stakes (G3) for the second year in a row to cap a three-stakes program July 25 at Woodbine.

title_en: Built Delivers Graded Breakthrough in Vanderbilt
description: Built, long considered one of the nation's best horses to not have a graded stakes victory, sheds that label July 25 at Saratoga Race Course in scoring a 2 1/2-length victory over Hymn in the $400,000 Alfred G. Vanderbilt Stakes (G2).

title_en: Counting Stars Best in Coaching Club American Oaks
description: The rubber match between Counting Stars and Always a Runner in the Coaching Club American Oaks (G1) July 25 at Saratoga Race Course was on full display at the top of the stretch, but Counting Stars pulled away for a decisive 4 1/4-length victory.

title_en: My Miss Mo Uncatchable in Monmouth Oaks
description: Saffie Joseph Jr. trainee My Miss Mo scores a hard-fought wire-to-wire victory in the $150,000 Monmouth Oaks (G3) July 25 at Monmouth Park, where she fought off Bodacious Bay to score by 1 1/2 lengths.

title_en: Brown Earns $75K Bonus for Haskell Trainer Challenge
description: Trainer Chad Brown picked up a consecutive $150,000 Haskell Weekend Trainer Challenge from July 17-19, earning a $75,000 bonus for his victory. He had a total of four wins on the July 18 Haskell card at Monmouth Park, including two graded stakes.

title_en: Calusa First Winner for Freshman Sire Aloha West
description: Calusa becomes the first winner for freshman sire Aloha West with a front-running 3 1/4-length debut victory in a 5-furlong turf dash July 25 at Gulfstream Park.

title_en: Kalpana Upsets Calandagan in King George
description: Kalpana reverses last year's King George VI and Queen Elizabeth Stakes (G1) form with Calandagan in scoring by 1 1/2 lengths in the July 25 race at Ascot Racecourse.

title_en: Ortiz Pleased with Magnitude's July 25 Whitney Work
description: Jockey Jose Ortiz reacts to Magnitude's July 25 breeze on Saratoga Race Course's Oklahoma Training Track—which he completed in 1:00.20 for 5 furlongs—and shares his thoughts on how the Aug. 8 Whitney Stakes (G1) is shaping up.

title_en: Longtime Del Mar CEO Harper Announces Retirement
description: Joe Harper, CEO of the Del Mar Thoroughbred Club, will transition from his day-to-day role and will assume the title of CEO Emeritus at the end of this year, Del Mar officials announced July 24.

title_en: Judge OKs Sale Order for Bankrupt Hawthorne
description: A bankruptcy judge has agreed to an order authorizing the sale of bankrupt Hawthorne Race Course to a developer. An Aug. 31 closing hinges on relocating horses and backstretch workers.

title_en: Report: Phileas Fogg Pointed Toward Whitney
description: Suburban Stakes (G2) victor Phileas Fogg is headed to the Aug. 8 Whitney Stakes (G1) at Saratoga Race Course, according to a Daily Racing Form report.

title_en: Medication Violations Cost Diodoro $70,000 in Purses
description: The trainer had controlled medication violations in six horses that ran in March at Turf Paradise, including five winners.

title_en: Alta Regina, Velozee Hook Up in Princess Margaret
description: Two-year-old fillies seek to make a name for themselves in the Princess Margaret Stakes (G3) July 25 at Ascot Racecourse. The winner will qualify for the Breeders' Cup Juvenile Fillies Turf (G1T) Oct. 30 at Keeneland.

title_en: Cabo Spirit, Gold Phoenix Give Read a Seasoned Look
description: The durable Cabo Spirit will try to improve on his second-place finish in the 2025 Eddie Read Stakes (G2T) when he faces local stars Gold Phoenix and Formidable Man in the 53rd running of the 1 1/8-mile turf event July 26 at Del Mar.

title_en: WATCH: Scottish Lassie Completes Prep for Shuvee
description: Assistant news editor and BloodHorse Monday co-host Sean Collins goes behind the scenes with trainer Jorge Abreu July 23, the morning before Scottish Lassie runs in the $250,000 Shuvee Stakes (G2) July 24 at Saratoga Race Course.

title_en: Bing Crosby Stakes At a Glance: Cornucopian Formidable
description: Nine talented sprinters line up for the $400,000 Bing Crosby Stakes (G1) July 25 at Del Mar. The 6-furlong contest draws in two-time grade 3 winner Cornucopian and recent Triple Bend Stakes (G3) winner Stronghold as highlights.

title_en: Three Graded Stakes Highlight July 25 Woodbine Card
description: Woodbine shines the graded spotlight on female horses July 25, presenting three CA$175,000 stakes: the Ontario Colleen Stakes (G3T) for 3-year-old fillies at a mile on turf, followed by the Hendrie Stakes (G3) and the Trillium Stakes (G3) on Tapeta.

title_en: Benvenuto Cellini Faces Elders in Stellar King George
description: Aidan O'Brien has declared Benvenuto Cellini and Minnie Hauk among his team of four for one of the biggest races of the flat season in the King George VI and Queen Elizabeth Stakes (G1) July 25 at Ascot Racecourse.

title_en: Journalism Retired to Stud Duty Due to Injury
description: After anticipating the break early in the San Diego Handicap (G2), Journalism was caught disadvantaged when the latch sprung, sustained an injury in the process, and still won. The son of Curlin will stand at Ashford Stud.

title_en: Expatriate Stallion Mutasaabeq Sires First Winner
description: John Guarnere's homebred Johnny G won in his second career start July 22 at Delaware Park.

title_en: Multiple Leading Ohio Sire Dominus Dies at 18
description: Dominus, a graded stakes-winning son of Smart Strike, had to be euthanized after developing complications related to lymphoma.

title_en: Baby Vino's Lineage Shines in Hallmark Haskell Win
description: Porter on Pedigrees examines the lineage of Baby Vino, winner of the Haskell Stakes and son of Spendthrift stallion Vino Rosso.

title_en: Juveniles Effusive, Salahudin Deliver on Debut
description: Effusive and Salahudin are BloodHorse Maiden Watch Hot Prospects after victorious debuts last week.

title_en: Deceptive, Dam of Mizdirection, Dies at 27
description: Mizdirection won the Breeders' Cup Turf Sprint (G1) in 2012 and 2013, and retired with more than $1.7 million in earnings. She would sell later as a broodmare prospect for $2.7 million. She was the second stakes winner produced by Deceptive.

title_en: NTRA Calls for Restoring Full Deduction on Winnings
description: Citing handle declines this year, the NTRA sent a letter July 17 to U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent calling on the Treasury and the IRS to back legislation that would restore the gambling loss provision to the previous level.

title_en: Johanna Walsh Continues Sire Sea The Stars' Momentum
description: Johanna Walsh built on the promise of her Ribblesdale Stakes (G2) runner-up effort with classic glory in the Irish Oaks (G1) July 18 at the Curragh. She is the 26th individual group 1 or grade 1 winner for her sire, the brilliant Sea The Stars.

title_en: Proletariat First Stakes Winner for Raging Bull
description: Proletariat becomes the first stakes winner for second-crop sire Raging Bull in notching a front-running triumph in the $153,000 Oceanside Stakes at Del Mar on the track's opening day of its summer meet, July 17.

title_en: War Front Pensioned Following 2026 Breeding Season
description: Claiborne Farm's prominent and internationally successful sire War Front, a son of Danzig, sired 121 black-type winners worldwide, including 26 grade/group 1 winners. His progeny earned more than $113 million.

title_en: Book Value Upgrades to Mandaloun's First Stakes Winner
description: The 2-year-old gelding is now 2-for-2 for owner Marion Gorham. Book Value was bred and is trained by Robert Gorham, Marion's brother.

title_en: Kornacki Among Racing and Gaming Conference Speakers
description: The Racing and Gaming Conference at Saratoga announced July 16 an exceptional lineup of speakers for its 2026 conference Aug. 10-12 at the Hilton in Saratoga Springs, N.Y.

title_en: Stonerside Co-Founder Janice McNair Dies at 89
description: Janice McNair, who founded Stonerside Stable with her husband Bob in 1984 before leaving the industry to launch the National Football League's Houston Texans, died July 14. She was 89.

title_en: Retired Ghostzapper Continues to Impress as a Sire
description: In this week's Porter on Pedigrees, Ghostzapper was represented during the July 11-12 weekend by similarly bred graded stakes winner Ole Crazy Bone and stakes winner Ghost Me.

title_en: CTHS Ontario Details Enhanced Breeders' Incentives
description: The Canadian Thoroughbred Horse Society announces details of Ontario's Breeders' Awards and breeder incentive programs, made possible through the CA$5 million increase to Ontario Racing's Thoroughbred Improvement Program.

title_en: Girvin Filly at $450,000 Leads McCrocklin's $1.46M Haul
description: Pinhooker Tom McCrocklin emerges as the leading yearling buyer July 14 during The July Sale at Fasig-Tipton in Lexington, purchasing eight yearlings, led by Hip 166, a daughter of Girvin who brought $450,000 to top the filly market.

title_en: Four Star Sales Welcomes Hamilton to its Team
description: Four Star Sales has announced that Grace Hamilton has joined the company as bloodstock and sales coordinator. Hamilton joins Four Star following graduation from the internationally respected Godolphin Flying Start program.

title_en: Crazy Hot Mess Becomes First U.S. Winner for Pinehurst
description: Crazy Hot Mess became the first winner in the U.S. for Walmac Farm's Pinehurst when the 2-year-old filly broke her maiden on debut at Ellis Park to win a maiden special weight race by 1 1/4 lengths.

title_en: Liam's Law Becomes First Winner for Colonel Liam
description: Liam's Law became the first winner for Ocala Stud's multiple graded stakes winner and freshman sire Colonel Liam, after breaking his maiden July 12 in a maiden special weight race over the turf at Saratoga Race Course.

title_en: Taylor Made Offers Half Sister to Booked
description: First-crop sire Two Phil's will be represented by Hip 52, a half sister to recent Sanford Stakes (G3) winner Booked. The filly sells July 14 at Fasig-Tipton's The July Sale with potential to become her dam's third stakes performer.

title_en: Rattle N Roll Retired, Heads to Stud in Saudi Arabia
description: Grade 1 winner Rattle N Roll, an earner of nearly $4 million, has been retired from racing at age 7 because of bone bruising, and will begin a stallion career in Saudi Arabia in 2027, according to co-owner Mike Mackin of Lucky Seven Stable.
